title: "SimulateSpread"
format: html
embed-resources: true
---

```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
```

```{r LoadData}
australia <- terra::vect("1_Data/Spatial/STE_2021_AUST_SHP_GDA2020/STE_2021_AUST_GDA2020.shp")
currentInfections <- read_csv("1_Data/Spatial/h5n1_detections_FAO_03092026.csv") |>
  filter(Country == "Australia") |>
  terra::vect(geom = c("longitude", "latitude"),
              crs = terra::crs(australia))
```

```{r Rasterise}
# Rasterise australia
australia_raster_blank <- rast(australia, res = 0.01)
australia_raster <- rasterize(australia, australia_raster_blank)

# Rasterise infections
infections_raster <- rasterize(currentInfections, 
                               australia_raster_blank) |>
  terra::classify(rcl = matrix(c(1, 2),
                               ncol = 2),
                  others = 1)


```
